title: Made a Walking Game For Friends and Fam
author: SFPleb
selftext:
Wanted to find more motivation to take walks and made this walking app in my spare time. The core gameplay loop is you walk to get “Stepins” that can buy cosmetics to customize your character. You can enter fashion contests, flex rare items/certain variations of items behind in-game events, and try to maintain the top spot on the leaderboard. Hold it for too long and you’ll have a bounty on your head to motivate players to dethrone you. You can also send notes and customize them with different font colors, different note colors, and a variety of different stamps. 

Definitely still a work in progress, but I pretty much just used Codex to code the app itself using Expo. I’ve used Kreska art for all the art in the game, which is a free browser tool. Currently only on iOS but hope to have it on android soon. Overall, has been a super fun process and I wanted to share it here since I think everyone in my personal life is over hearing about it lol.
